title: flywheel: orch_grade_outcome input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_grade_outcome instead; removed in v4.0] Grade the cycle outcome with a model strictly decorrelated from the impl swarm — codex primary, fresh-CC fallback. Called from skills/start/_wrapup.md Step 9.5 before commit review. Reads state.outcomeRubricPath; short-circuits to kind=grading_skipped when state.outcomeGradingSkipped is true. Persists verdict to .pi-flywheel/plans/<slug>/grading/iteration-<N>.json. Discriminator on success: kind ∈ { grader_verdict, grading_skipped, grading_capped (max_iterations_reached server-side coerced), grading_persistence_failed (verdict in-memory; disk write failed) }.

planSlug.description: Plan slug. Optional; defaults to slugifying state.outcomeRubricPath.

force.description: Bypass the iteration-N.json-exists guard and the in-memory mutex.
